title: monitors list (schema_version 1)
description: Read-only output of `dotfiles-runtime monitors list --format json` (REQ-009). Runtime-owned per capture EPIC-002 D9; not part of the `contracts` repo program tuple. Monitors are the connected, enabled, non-mirrored Hyprland outputs, ordered by geometry.x, geometry.y, connector. Detection failure (headless/CI, missing binary, invalid payload) is not an error: source is `unavailable` and monitors is empty.

source.description: hyprland = at least one targetable output was read from the compositor; unavailable = no targetable output (headless, detection failure, or an empty/filtered set).

monitors.description: Canonical order: geometry.x ascending, then geometry.y, then connector ascending.

connector.description: Stable output id; the exact value the capture backend takes for --monitor.

scale.description: Compositor logical scale (display/join data, not capture math).

focused.description: Compositor focused output; at most one is true.

mirror_of.description: Diagnostic mirror source; null for an independent output. Mirrored outputs are filtered from monitors, so this is null in practice.
